description: This PHP source code defines the 'Icon' class within the 'Goteo\Model\Call' namespace. The class manages call icons, providing methods to retrieve, save, validate, and remove icon associations for calls/projects in a database. It includes database interaction, localization considerations, and encapsulates logic for handling icon data related to calls.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: Represents call icons with methods to retrieve, validate, save, and remove icon associations from the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves icon data for a specific call ID from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all available icons, considering language localization.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Retrieves icon names, optionally filtered by call ID and limited in number, with localization support.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the icon object ensuring required properties are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the icon-call association into the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the icon association from a call.
